eventDetail.scope: The scope of the International Conference on Computer Applications and Artificial Intelligence (ICCAAI) is to provide an international forum where researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and students present and discuss advances in computer applications, artificial intelligence, and related technologies. The conference encourages both theoretical research and practical applications that address real-world challenges
